usedFor: DocuSeal holds forms and signed submissions, Hastewire makes text sound natural, and “Submission Completed” in DocuSeal can start “Humanize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “Submission Completed” in DocuSeal, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: Each finished DocuSeal submission can be followed by text made to sound natural in Hastewire.

watchOut: “New Template” in DocuSeal is polling while “Template Created” is pushed, so choose “Template Created” for the quicker start.
